mapper.sql: p.product_id, p.seller_id, p.title, p.cover, p.images, p.price, p.original_price, p.`condition`, p.cat_l1, p.cat_l2, p.shipping_method, p.shipping_fee, p.stock, p.status, p.description, p.location, p.city, p.view_count, p.want_count, p.chat_count, p.publish_time, p.is_pinned, p.purchase_date, p.create_time, p.update_time, p.tenant_id
mapper.select:
SELECT , u.nick_name AS seller_nick_name, u.avatar AS seller_avatar FROM product p LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON p.seller_id = u.user_id
AND p.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND p.status = #{status} AND p.cat_l1 = #{catL1} AND p.city = #{city}
AND MATCH(p.title, p.description) AGAINST(#{keyword})
AND p.seller_id = #{sellerId}
ORDER BY p.price ASC ORDER BY p.price DESC ORDER BY p.view_count DESC, p.publish_time DESC ORDER BY p.is_pinned DESC, p.hot_score DESC, p.publish_time DESC
ORDER BY MATCH(p.title, p.description) AGAINST(#{keyword}) DESC, p.publish_time DESC
ORDER BY p.is_pinned DESC, p.publish_time DESC
SELECT , u.nick_name AS seller_nick_name, u.avatar AS seller_avatar FROM product p LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON p.seller_id = u.user_id WHERE p.product_id = #{productId} AND p.tenant_id = #{tenantId}

SELECT , p.hot_score, u.nick_name AS seller_nick_name, u.avatar AS seller_avatar FROM product p LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON p.seller_id = u.user_id WHERE p.status = 'onsale' AND p.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND p.cat_l1 IN #{cat} AND p.publish_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) ORDER BY p.publish_time DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT , p.hot_score, u.nick_name AS seller_nick_name, u.avatar AS seller_avatar FROM product p LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON p.seller_id = u.user_id WHERE p.status = 'onsale' AND p.tenant_id = #{tenantId} ORDER BY p.hot_score DESC, p.publish_time DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT , p.hot_score, u.nick_name AS seller_nick_name, u.avatar AS seller_avatar FROM product p LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON p.seller_id = u.user_id WHERE p.status = 'onsale' AND p.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND p.publish_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) ORDER BY p.publish_time DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT , p.hot_score, u.nick_name AS seller_nick_name, u.avatar AS seller_avatar FROM product p LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON p.seller_id = u.user_id WHERE p.status = 'onsale' AND p.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND p.city = #{city} AND p.publish_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) ORDER BY p.hot_score DESC, p.publish_time DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT , p.hot_score, u.nick_name AS seller_nick_name, u.avatar AS seller_avatar FROM product p LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON p.seller_id = u.user_id WHERE p.status = 'onsale' AND p.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND p.seller_id IN #{sid} ORDER BY p.publish_time DESC

SELECT , p.hot_score, u.nick_name AS seller_nick_name, u.avatar AS seller_avatar FROM product p LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON p.seller_id = u.user_id WHERE p.status = 'onsale' AND p.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND p.product_id IN #{pid}
mapper.update: UPDATE product p LEFT JOIN ( SELECT product_id, COUNT(*) AS v7 FROM product_view_log WHERE view_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 7 DAY) GROUP BY product_id ) s ON s.product_id = p.product_id SET p.hot_score = (COALESCE(s.v7, 0) + p.want_count * 3 + p.chat_count * 2) / POW(TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, LEAST(COALESCE(p.publish_time, p.create_time, NOW()), NOW()), NOW()) / 24 + 2, 1.2) WHERE COALESCE(p.publish_time, p.create_time) IS NOT NULL
mapper.select: SELECT product_id FROM product_favorite WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO product (seller_id, title, cover, images, price, original_price, `condition`, cat_l1, cat_l2, shipping_method, shipping_fee, stock, status, description, location, city, purchase_date, publish_time, create_time, update_time , tenant_id) VALUES (#{sellerId}, #{title}, #{cover}, #{images}, #{price}, #{originalPrice}, #{condition}, #{catL1}, #{catL2}, #{shippingMethod}, #{shippingFee}, #{stock}, #{status}, #{description}, #{location}, #{city}, #{purchaseDate}, #{publishTime}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime} , #{tenantId})
mapper.update: UPDATE product SET status = IF(stock <= 1, 'locked', status), stock = stock - 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE product_id = #{productId} AND stock > 0 AND status = 'onsale' AND tenant_id = #{tenantId}
mapper.select: SELECT snapshot FROM product_draft WHERE seller_id = #{sellerId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO product_draft (seller_id, snapshot, update_time) VALUES (#{sellerId}, #{snapshot}, NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE snapshot = VALUES(snapshot), update_time = NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM product WHERE seller_id = #{sellerId} AND status = 'sold'
